title: Encapsulate public mutable state
why: Publicly writable state lets callers bypass invariants and couples them to representation details.
suggestion: Make the field private and expose behavior or a deliberately constrained immutable view.
limitations: Types explicitly named Mutable followed by a domain type name and configuration models ending in Config, Configuration, Options, or Settings are treated as intentionally mutable containers.

At most one representative finding is reported per type. Class, enum, record, and struct declarations must begin a source statement; declaration prose, C# expression-bodied properties, events, and operator declarations, plus Dart operator declarations, are excluded. Java and C# fields are reported only when every enclosing type is public.
